mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_favorites (user_id, product_id, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{productId}, #{createdAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM product_favorites WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND product_id = #{productId})

SELECT p.id AS product_id, p.name, p.image, p.sales_price AS price, p.market_price AS market_price, p.stock, p.listing_status AS status, f.created_at FROM product_favorites f JOIN products p ON p.id = f.product_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.created_at DESC, f.id DESC
